[SWS_PER_00499]
d
When
ara::per::KeyValueStorage::SetValue
is called
for an existing
key-value pair
,
Persistency
shall check whether the tem-
plated data type matches the stored data type, and otherwise return directly with
kDataTypeMismatch
.
c
(RS_PER_00001, RS_PER_00003)
